attributes.description: Distribution opsdir-adapter-bmc-helix (import opsdir_adapter_bmc_helix), registered via entry point opsdir.adapters:bmc-helix; depends on opsdir.
attributes.external_dependencies: ["BMC AR System REST API (GET /api/arsys/v1/entry/CHG:Infrastructure Change, /api/arsys/v1/entry/AP:Detail-Signature, read-only)"]
attributes.purpose: BMC Helix ITSM / Remedy as an ITSM add-on (kind itsm). It reads the change tickets the record's change records link (bmc-helix:<Infrastructure Change ID>) as evidence. Importer bmc-helix/change-requests reads AR System REST answers of CHG:Infrastructure Change and AP:Detail-Signature, mapping statuses through the setting bmc-helix-status-states (BMC's documented list by default). The approval is rejected on status Rejected and otherwise derived from the signatures grouped by Approval ID. A read-only collector uses an AR-JWT or bearer token minted outside opsdir.

attributes.description: Read-only linkage of recorded changes (ciamChange.ciamTicketRef '<adapter>:<number>') to their ITSM tickets. An ITSM add-on's importer (offline export, or a read-only collector via ciamCollectionSource) records each linked ticket as observed evidence: ciamTicket under cn=<number>,ou=<adapter>,ou=tickets, holding the neutral state, the overall approval (derived from per-step decisions where the system approves by steps, kept as approval steps), the neutral change type (standard/normal/emergency), planned and work windows, approver rows, raw facts and the provider id. A ticket is never written under ou=changes and is never an approval opsdir acts on. Where a system's states and fields are site-specific, the operator maps them in the add-on's estate settings ('<name>=<value>, ...'). The governance domain reconciles record vs ticket (in-step, not-imported, rejected, cancelled, unapproved, closed-pending, live-but-rejected, window-differs, outside-window) in a planner check and the tickets report. Add-ons (kind itsm): ServiceNow, Jira Service Management (Cloud and Data Center) and BMC Helix ITSM / Remedy (AR System REST).

attributes.name: status_states
attributes.purpose: The operator's status map from jira-sm-status-states: {status id or exact name: neutral ticket state}, the first of a status mapped twice; with the problems of entries that aren't one (a state outside governance TICKET_STATES, a status mapped twice, malformed parts).

attributes.name: field_refs
attributes.purpose: The operator's field mapping from jira-sm-change-fields: {role (planned-start, planned-end, work-start, work-end, change-type, or another fact name): field id or exact name}, with the problems of entries that aren't one.

attributes.name: jira_time
attributes.purpose: (GeneralizedTime or None, problem or None) of a Jira date-time value: ISO 8601 with its offset converted to UTC; a date without a time (a Date Picker field) or anything else is refused with why.

attributes.name: overall_approval
attributes.parameters: [{"name": "steps", "type": "tuple[dict] | None", "required": true}, {"name": "state", "type": "str | None", "required": true, "description": "the ticket's neutral state"}]
attributes.purpose: A request's overall approval from its steps' own decisions (never from single approvers; user decision task 551 Q2a): any declined -> rejected; else any pending -> requested; else at least one step, all approved, and the ticket's neutral state past authorize -> approved; else None (no steps: unknown, never not-requested).

attributes.name: step_rows
attributes.purpose: The approval steps of one request as ciamTicketApprovalStep values (user decision S1a): '<finalDecision> <step id> created <GeneralizedTime>[ completed <GeneralizedTime>]', sorted.

attributes.name: setting_pairs
attributes.purpose: Parse a mapping setting's '<name>=<value>, ...' text (an operator's mapping, such as an ITSM add-on's status map) into its pairs, and name the parts that aren't a pair.

attributes.name: setting_mapping
attributes.purpose: The pairs of a mapping setting's value in effect (the record's, else the declared default), with its problems named for the setting: malformed parts, and a name mapped more than once (the first is used).

attributes.name: ticket_state_map
attributes.parameters: [{"name": "d", "type": "Directory", "required": true}, {"name": "setting", "type": "Setting", "required": true, "description": "the add-on's declared status-mapping setting"}]
attributes.purpose: An ITSM add-on's status-mapping setting ('<status>=<state>, ...', the record's value or the add-on's default) as {the system's status: neutral ticket state}: the first mapping of a status is used, and states outside TICKET_STATES are named and left out. Shared by jira-sm and bmc-helix.

attributes.name: iso_date_time
attributes.purpose: Read an ISO 8601 date-time as GeneralizedTime, converting its offset to UTC (no offset means UTC). A date without a time is refused with DATE_WITHOUT_TIME (its time zone is unknown), and anything else with a reason. Shared by the ITSM add-ons' window readers.
attributes.returns: {"type": "tuple[str | None, str | None]", "description": "(GeneralizedTime, None) or (None, why not)"}

attributes.name: derived_approval
attributes.parameters: [{"name": "decisions", "type": "iterable[str]", "required": true, "description": "each step's decision: approved, declined or pending"}, {"name": "state", "type": "str | None", "required": true, "description": "the ticket's neutral state"}]
attributes.purpose: A ticket's overall approval derived from its approval steps' own decisions, for systems that approve by steps and report no overall approval (the user's rule from task 551). Any declined gives rejected. Otherwise any pending gives requested. Otherwise, at least one step, all approved, with the neutral state past authorization (PAST_AUTHORIZE), gives approved. Anything else gives None (unknown). Shared by jira-sm and bmc-helix.

attributes.name: approval_step
attributes.parameters: [{"name": "decision", "type": "str | None", "required": true}, {"name": "step", "type": "str | None", "required": true}, {"name": "created", "type": "str | None", "required": true, "description": "GeneralizedTime"}, {"name": "completed", "type": "str | None", "required": false, "description": "GeneralizedTime; None omits the part"}]
attributes.purpose: Format one ciamTicketApprovalStep value: '<decision> <step id> created <time>[ completed <time>]', with '?' for what the system didn't say.

attributes.name: change_type
attributes.purpose: The neutral change type of a BMC Change Timing value: Emergency, Normal and Standard map to emergency, normal and standard; Expedited, Latent and No Impact give None (kept as facts).

attributes.name: step_decision
attributes.purpose: An approval step's decision from its AP:Detail-Signature statuses: declined when any is Rejected; otherwise pending when any is Pending/Hold/More Information; otherwise approved when any is Approved. Returns None when only Cancelled, Error or Closed.

attributes.name: overall_approval
attributes.parameters: [{"name": "status", "type": "str", "required": true, "description": "Change Request Status"}, {"name": "decisions", "type": "iterable[str]", "required": true}, {"name": "state", "type": "str | None", "required": true, "description": "neutral state"}]
attributes.purpose: A BMC change ticket's overall approval: rejected when its Change Request Status is Rejected, else derived from its steps' decisions (tickets.derived_approval).

attributes.name: ar_error
attributes.purpose: What an AR System REST error answer says ([{messageType, messageNumber, messageText, messageAppendedText}, ...]), or None when the document isn't one.

attributes.name: answer_entries
attributes.purpose: The entries of an AR System entry answer: a list answer's entries ({"entries": [...]}) or a single entry ({"values": {...}}), each having a values object.

attributes.name: has_next
attributes.purpose: Whether an AR System list answer links a next page (_links.next).

attributes.name: self_link
attributes.purpose: An AR System entry's REST self link (_links.self[].href), or None.

attributes.name: approval_key
attributes.purpose: The change number an approval answer file is for (.../approval/<CRQ>/<offset>.json as collected, or approval-<CRQ>*.json as an operator saves it), or None.

attributes.name: signatures_of
attributes.parameters: [{"name": "values", "type": "dict", "required": true, "description": "the change entry's values"}, {"name": "signatures", "type": "iterable[dict]", "required": true, "description": "signature values"}]
attributes.purpose: The AP:Detail-Signature rows belonging to one change. A row belongs when its Request is the change's Request ID or its Infrastructure Change ID. Rows are deduplicated by Detail-Sig-Id and split into the change's own (Application CHG:Infrastructure Change or none) and those of another application.

attributes.name: steps_of
attributes.purpose: A change's approval steps from its signatures, grouped by Approval ID: each with its decision (step_decision, None when undecided) and its first Create-Date-Sig as GeneralizedTime.
attributes.returns: {"type": "tuple[tuple[str, str | None, str | None]]", "description": "((Approval ID, decision, created), ...) by Approval ID"}

attributes.name: approver_rows
attributes.purpose: A change's signatures as ciamTicketApprover values: '<status> <Approver Signature, else Approvers> step <Approval ID> updated <Modified-Date-Sig>[ phase <Phase>]'. These are login ids, never names, with whitespace in a token turned to '_'.

attributes.name: ticket_facts
attributes.parameters: [{"name": "entry", "type": "dict", "required": true}, {"name": "signatures", "type": "tuple[dict] | None", "required": true}, {"name": "states", "type": "dict[str, str]", "required": true, "description": "{status: neutral state}"}]
attributes.purpose: The ticket attributes of one CHG:Infrastructure Change entry and its signatures (None: approvals not read): neutral state by the status map, overall approval, native state, change type from Change Timing, planned/work windows (offset date-times, date-only refused), steps, approver rows, facts, provider ref, doc URL, title; and the problems to name.

attributes.name: read_changes
attributes.parameters: [{"name": "files", "type": "dict[str, str]", "required": true}, {"name": "d", "type": "Directory", "required": true}, {"name": "patterns", "type": "tuple", "required": true}, {"name": "at", "type": "datetime | None", "required": false, "description": "when the export was taken"}]
attributes.purpose: The importer bmc-helix/change-requests reads saved AR System REST answers into the record's ticket evidence. Each linked change becomes its own import group, which replaces only that ticket. Notices name: unmapped statuses, incomplete approvals, other applications' signatures, unlinked changes, linked changes the export lacks, errors and non-answers. An export spanning several servers is refused, and so is an undated one.

attributes.name: credential
attributes.purpose: The Request credential of a bmc-helix collection source. For scheme token, the JWT goes in Authorization after the prefix 'AR-JWT ' (the core's api-key credential). For bearer, it is a bearer token.

attributes.name: entry_url
attributes.parameters: [{"name": "base", "type": "str", "required": true}, {"name": "form", "type": "str", "required": true}, {"name": "qualification", "type": "str", "required": true}, {"name": "fields", "type": "tuple[str]", "required": true}, {"name": "limit", "type": "int", "required": true}, {"name": "offset", "type": "int", "required": false}]
attributes.purpose: The URL of a qualified AR System entry read (GET /api/arsys/v1/entry/<form>?q=..&fields=values(..)&limit=..&offset=..), with the form, qualification and field names percent-encoded.

attributes.name: entries_view
attributes.purpose: The keep function for an entry answer: only each entry's requested values and self link, plus the answer's next link. Error answers and non-JSON are kept as they are.

attributes.name: change_steps
attributes.purpose: The collector's calls: first a qualified read (limit 2) of CHG:Infrastructure Change for each linked change, then, for each change read, the AP:Detail-Signature pages (the Request ID or the CRQ), each after a page that links a next one.

attributes.name: source_problems
attributes.purpose: Why bmc-helix's collection sources can't be read: an unbound credential or trust anchor, no location, or a credential scheme other than token or bearer.

attributes.description: Milestone 107 item (analysis note 3064; worker). A new package opsdir-adapter-bmc-helix (kind itsm), the third ITSM after ServiceNow (task 532) and Jira SM (task 551), reusing their contract unchanged where it fits: ciamTicketRef on ciamChange, observed ciamTicket under ou=tickets, ciamTicketApprovalStep (834) and ciamTicketChangeType (835) from decision 3167, ticket evidence, never an approval. Read-only: BMC Helix ITSM / Remedy AR System REST API (CHG:Infrastructure Change form, approval forms), JWT login, least-privilege read user, on-premises vs Helix SaaS, any government cloud offering; export importer if research supports one. Research current BMC docs first via Codex (read-only); design to the master before coding (operator mapping as estate settings like jira-sm, record changes escalate). Showcase ids reserved: CHG-2105..2109, planted A250..A259, B105..B109.

attributes.description: setting_mapping parses the setting's text with setting_pairs
setting_mapping reads the value in effect with setting_value
ticket_state_map reads the status-mapping setting's pairs with setting_mapping
status_states delegates to ticket_state_map with jira-sm-status-states
field_refs reads jira-sm-change-fields' pairs with setting_mapping
iso_date_time reads the date-time with gtime_of_iso
jira_time delegates to iso_date_time, adding Jira's hint for a date-only field
step_rows formats each step with approval_step
overall_approval delegates to derived_approval with the steps' finalDecision values
